description: This Java class 'FeignTransactionHelper' provides helper methods for interacting with loan transactions via a FineractFeignClient. It simplifies operations such as adding repayments, interest waivers, charge-offs, chargebacks, and undoing repayments, by wrapping the underlying client calls with additional logic and request preparation.

classes.name: FeignTransactionHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing loan transactions through FineractFeignClient, providing methods for repayment, interest waiver, charge-off, chargeback, and undo operations.

methods.name: addRepayment
methods.description: Adds a repayment transaction to a specific loan, returning the resource ID of the created transaction.

methods.name: addInterestWaiver
methods.description: Adds an interest waiver transaction to a specific loan, returning the resource ID.

methods.name: chargeOff
methods.description: Performs a charge-off on a specified loan, returning the resource ID.

methods.name: addChargeback
methods.description: Performs a chargeback on a specific loan transaction, returning the resource ID.

methods.name: undoRepayment
methods.description: Undoes a repayment transaction by setting transaction amount to zero and updating transaction date.
